title: Occupation task kits for shared O*NET work activities
description: Each item is a kit for one information-work activity that O*NET 31.0 links to many occupations through its detailed work activities (DWAs). A kit holds a standard-library Python helper with typed JSON input and output (JSON Schema in the contract) that does the mechanical part of the activity and refuses bad input with a reason code, a procedure an agent follows (questions to ask first, steps, decision points, quality checks, scenario variants), a tools note that separates the software O*NET lists for the occupations from inferred tool choices, a known-good and a known-wrong example, and an O*NET attribution file naming the DWA, task and occupation identifiers used. The shared kit_schema.py validates a JSON Schema subset; the shared test_package.py runs both examples, checks the files against component.json and fails when the kit's public functions are replaced by ones that raise. There is no native engine check: the Python runs in the qualification sandbox. Activity selection, cue rules and tool notes are inference from O*NET data, stated as such in each kit.

engine.name: python
engine.notes: Standard library only; pure functions of JSON input; no network, file or process effects
